# CWE-798: npm registry auth token in an .npmrc line.

# ruleid: detected-npm-registry-auth-token
_auth = "dXNlcjpwYXNzd29yZAo="
# ok: detected-npm-registry-auth-token

# ok: detected-npm-registry-auth-token
registry = "https://registry.npmjs.org/"
